verdict.rationale: The evidence only touches on prompt-driven building. Zapier Copilot helps users create specialized agents (docs-8), and Canvas claims to automatically map processes to help automate them (docs-18). The MCP plain-language claim (docs-20) is about executing single actions, not building workflows, and no evidence shows a Zap being generated or edited from a natural-language prompt. Missing for 10: documented prompt-to-Zap generation, natural-language editing of existing workflows, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
